 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Wake Up Your Roots – Every Morning!

Meet the morning ritual your scalp will thank you for! Infused with Redensyl, Capilia Longa, and Rosemary, this ultra-light rice-based mist is your AM boost for visible hair regrowth. This pack of 2 dives deep to energize dormant follicles, reduce thinning, and revive natural volume – all while keeping your scalp fresh and balanced.

✨ Why You’ll Love It:

• 
Activates and strengthens weak roots

• 
Helps regenerate hair with clinically-backed actives

• 
Tames frizz, hydrates strands & leaves zero residue

Whether you’re stepping into a meeting or heading out in the sun – spray and go! No buildup, no fuss. Just healthier, fuller-looking hair, one spritz at a time.

Rice (Oryza sativa) Protein, Plant Keratin Protein

 Product Benefits
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 • Reduces Hair Fall: Strengthens weak roots with Redensyl + Capilia Longa.

• Boosts Hair Regrowth: Helps activate dormant follicles for baby hair growth.

• Improves Hair Density: Promotes fuller, thicker-looking hair over time.

• Daily Lightweight Formula: Non-sticky, easy to spray, perfect for all-day use.

• Nourishes Scalp: Soothes dryness, balances oil, and keeps scalp fresh.

• Clean & Safe: No mineral oil, parabens, sulfates, or harsh chemicals.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. How do I use Phus Phus All Day Mist?

Simply spray on your scalp, massage gently, and leave it on. Use daily for best results.

2. Can I use it along with oil or serum?

Yes, you can. Apply Phus Phus first, let it absorb, and then follow with your regular hair-care routine if needed.

3. Is it non-sticky?

Absolutely — it's a lightweight, water-based spray that leaves zero greasiness.

4. When will I start seeing results?

Most users begin noticing reduced hair fall and early baby hair growth within 4–8 weeks of consistent use.

5. Is it suitable for all hair types?

Yes — straight, curly, oily, dry, coloured, chemically treated — all hair types can use it daily.

6. Does it contain real Redensyl & Capilia Longa?

Yes — the formula is powered by clinically researched Redensyl + Capilia Longa for visible regrowth support.

7. Can I use it before styling or going out?

Yes — the non-oily, fresh mist makes it perfect for daytime use without weighing hair down.
